# Load dataset

```{r}
pop=readRDS("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\paper\\main_analysis\\with duration\\time_to_event\\population_rr_0.5.rds")
```

## Select some patients to run functions

Divide into treated and untreated

```{r}
trt=pop %>% filter(trt==1) 
untrt=pop %>% filter(trt==0) 
```

Smaller sample size

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
dftrial=rbind(trt[sample(1:nrow(trt),20),],
            untrt[sample(1:nrow(untrt),50),]) %>% 
  select(id,ageonset,sex,calendar,event,time,duration,trt)
```

# Test procedures

## Duration matching

```{r}
matched=duration_matching(dftrial,treatment=trt,duration=duration,time=time,ratio=1)
# extract dataset
matcheddf=matched$dataset %>% 
  mutate(event=ifelse(time_trial>730,0,1),
         time_trial=ifelse(time_trial>730,730,time_trial))
```

Model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
```

Risk ratio

```{r}
rr=risk_ratio(matcheddf,model=model,
              treatment="trt",estimand="ATT",landmark=730)
```

## Exact matching

```{r}
# match
matched=matching(data=dftrial,treatment=trt,
                   ageofonset=ageonset,sex=sex,
                   duration=duration,time=time,
                   method='greedy',
                   #caliper=NULL,step=NULL,maxcaliper=NULL,
                   caliper=1,step=0.1,maxcaliper=1,
                   ratio=1,
                   replacement=F,history=F,warning=T)

# extract dataset
matcheddf=matched$dataset %>% 
  mutate(event=ifelse(time_trial>730,0,1),
         time_trial=ifelse(time_trial>730,730,time_trial))
# number of events
table(matcheddf$trt,matcheddf$event)
```

### Point estimate

Run model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
```

Point estimate

```{r}
rr=risk_ratio(matcheddf,model=model,
              treatment="trt",estimand="ATT",landmark=730)
```

### bootstrap procedure

##### boot package

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       strata=dftrial[["trt"]],
       full_data=dftrial,
       estimand="ATT",
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimate="surv_rr",
       landmark=730,
       ratio=2,
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset,
       exact_arguments=list(caliper=NULL,
                            step=NULL,
                            maxcaliper=NULL),
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       method="exact",
       search=list(exact="optimal"))
```

Print estimates

```{r}
bate=B$t0[1]
lower=bate-1.96*sd(B$t[,1])
upper=bate+1.96*sd(B$t[,2])
# converged proportion?
mean(B$t[,2],na.rm=T)
# check all
B$t
```

##### by hand

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# set iterations
B=5
# collect estimates
rrs=c()
# loop through
for (i in 1:B){
  # resample ids
  idx=sample(nrow(dftrial), size = nrow(dftrial), replace = TRUE)
  # resample
  dfboot=dftrial[idx,]
  # redefine ids
  dfboot=dfboot %>% mutate(id=row_number())
  # run matching
  matched=matching(data=dfboot,treatment=trt,ageofonset=ageonset,sex=sex,
                   duration=duration,time=time,method='optimal',
                   caliper=NULL,step=NULL,maxcaliper=NULL,
                   #caliper=0.5,step=0.1,maxcaliper=0.5,
                   ratio=2,
                   replacement=F,history=F,warning=T)
  # extract dataset
  matcheddf=matched$dataset
  # model
  model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
  # caclulate risk ratio
  rr=risk_ratio(matcheddf,model=model,
                treatment="trt",estimand="ATT",landmark=730)
  # append
  rrs=c(rrs,rr)
}
```

## PSM

### glm

#### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching(data=dftrial,
                     formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                     ratio=2,
                     replacement=F,
                     distance='glm',
                     method='optimal',
                     #tune=TRUE,
                     #caliper=0.1,
                     duration=duration,
                     time=time)
# extract dataset
matcheddf=matched$dataset %>% 
  select(id,cluster,trt,time_trial,event,calendar) %>% 
  mutate(event=ifelse(time_trial>730,0,event),
         time_trial=ifelse(time_trial>730,730,time_trial))
# number of treated and untreated
table(matcheddf$trt)
```

#### Point estimate

Run model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
```

Point estimate

```{r}
rr=risk_ratio(matcheddf,model=model,treatment="trt",estimand="ATT",landmark=730)
```

#### bootstrap procedure

##### boot pacckage

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       strata=dftrial[["trt"]],
       full_data=dftrial,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       landmark=730,
       estimate="surv_rr",
       estimand="ATT",
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       method="psm",search=list(psm="optimal"),
       psm_arguments=list(caliper=NULL,
                          distance="glm",
                          seed=123,tune=FALSE))
```

Print estimates

```{r}
bate=B$t0[1]
lower=bate-1.96*sd(B$t[B$t[,2]==1,1])
upper=bate+1.96*sd(B$t[B$t[,2]==1,1])
# check all
B$t
```

##### by hand

```{r}
# parameters
betas=c(); B=5; nuntrt=c(); ntrt=c(); n=c(); rrs=c()
# loop
for (b in 1:B){
  # resample ids
  ## treated
  dfboot_trt=dftrial %>%
    filter(trt == 1) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 20, replace = TRUE)
  ## untreated
  dfboot_untrt=dftrial %>%
    filter(trt == 0) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 50, replace = TRUE)
  # bind together
  dfboot=bind_rows(dfboot_trt, dfboot_untrt) %>%
    mutate(id = row_number())
  # redefine ids
  dfboot=dfboot %>% mutate(id=row_number())
  # run matching
    ## own function
  matched=psm_matching(data=dfboot,
                       formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                       ratio=2,
                       replacement=F,
                       distance='mahalanobis',
                       method='optimal',
                       duration=duration,
                       time=time)
  ## extract dataset
  matcheddfp=matched$dataset
  # model
  model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,
              data=matcheddfp,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
  ## append quantities
  n=c(n,nrow(matcheddfp)); nuntrt=c(nuntrt,table(matcheddfp$trt)[1]); 
  ntrt=c(ntrt,table(matcheddfp$trt)[2]);   betas=c(betas,coef(model)[1])
  rrs=c(rrs,
        risk_ratio(matcheddfp,model=model,
                   treatment="trt",estimand='ATT',landmark=730))
}
betas; rrs
```

### random forest

#### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching(data=dftrial,
                     formula=trt~ageonset+I(ageonset^2)+sex,
                     ratio=2,
                     replacement=F,
                     distance='random forest',
                     method='optimal',
                     tune=FALSE,
                     caliper=NULL,
                     duration=duration,
                     time=time)
# extract dataset
matcheddf=matched$dataset
```

#### Point estimate

Run model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,x=T,model=T,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
```

Point estimate

```{r}
rr=risk_ratio(data=matcheddf,model=model,
              treatment="trt",estimand="ATT",landmark=730)
```

#### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       full_data=dftrial,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       ratio=2,
       estimate="surv_rr",
       estimand="ATT",
       search=list(psm="optimal"),
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       psm_arguments=list(caliper=NULL,
                          tune=TRUE,
                          seed=181299,
                          distance="random forest"),
       method="psm")
```

Print estimates

```{r}

```

### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       strata=dftrial[["trt"]],
       #indices=1:nrow(dftrial),
       full_data=dftrial,
       #replacement=T,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimand="ATT",
       ratio=2,
       landmark=730,
       estimate="surv_rr",
       search=list(psm="optimal"),
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+I(ageonset^2)+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       psm_arguments=list(tune=FALSE,distance="mahalanobis",caliper=NULL),

```

Print estimates

```{r}
bate=B$t0[1]

# converged proportion?
sum(B$t[,2])/length(B$t[,2])
# see all runs
B$t
```

#### by hand

```{r}
# parameters
betas=c(); B=5; nuntrt=c(); ntrt=c(); n=c(); rrs=c()
# loop
for (b in 1:B){
  # resample ids
  ## treated
  dfboot_trt=dftrial %>%
    filter(trt == 1) %>%

  ## untreated

  # run matching

                       formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                       ratio=2,

                       method='optimal',
                       duration=duration,
                       time=time)
  ## extract dataset

  # model
```
